meaning.intent: count the capabilities the current model declares
meaning.outcome: the caller observes how many capabilities the current model declares

scenarios.name: Count the capabilities the current model declares
scenarios.when: the declared read executes under the reader boundary
scenarios.then: the number of capabilities the current model declares is returned

configuration.statement: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS declaredCapabilities FROM model.estate_capability ec JOIN source.current_model cm ON cm.estate_model_pk=ec.estate_model_pk FOR JSON PATH,WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER) AS value
